verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that a Base44 app can be connected to GitHub so code written locally or in Base44 stays in sync both ways, covering version control, local development and collaboration (base44-docs-2, base44-docs-18). The CLI eject command adds a one-way export path for full code ownership (base44-docs-22). Missing for 10: details of how the sync works (repo ownership/selection, conflict handling, branch behavior), and independent or hands-on corroboration that bidirectional sync works in practice.
